initial_conditions: The exact offline Debian ARM64 package and original two-panel shirt under X11 with Mesa llvmpipe.
actions: Build and launch the package offline with the original shirt.
Use Ctrl+K then Escape and retain actual X11 window images.
Export glTF with the packaged CLI and compare both platforms and containers.
Close the studio normally; stop the owned display and guest.
expected_outcomes: Ctrl+K shows the palette and Export glTF; Escape restores identical workspace bytes. CLI JSON glTF matches macOS and the GLB geometry, and the fixture bytes are preserved.
